 Chikhali, Dist. Buldhana.

_______________________________________________________________________
Office Notes, Office Memoramda of Coram,
appearances, Court's orders of directions Court's or Judge's orders.
and Registrar's Orders.
Mr. M. N. Ali, Advocate for applicant.
Mr. N. B. Jawade, A.P.P. for non applicant-State.

Coram : V. M. Deshpande, J.
 Dated : September 13, 2019
Heard Mr. Ali, learned counsel for applicant and  Mr. Jawade, learned A.P.P. for non applicant-State.
Also  perused the reply filed.

Looking to the nature of accusations, this Court  (Coram: Manish Pitale, J.) on 14.08.2019, granted interim  protection to the applicant with a direction that applicant  shall attend Police Station on every Sunday during pendency  of the present application.
 It is not in dispute that applicant has attended the  Police Station and followed the conditions.

According to reply, on the basis of secret  information, patrolling party on 19.05.2019, conducted raid  in the premises of present applicant and seized pan masala  and ghutka hidden below a tadpatri.

Looking to said, prima  facie, it would would be a question of trial as to whether the  applicant was having conscious possession or not.

entities.text: Sharad Bhaskar Kharat vs State Of Mah., Thr. Police Station
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (i) The application is allowed.

(ii) In the event of arrest in connection with Crime No.414/2019, registered with Police Station, Chikhali for an offence punishable under Section 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 read with Sections 188, 272, 273 and 328 of the Indian Penal Code, applicant-Sharad s/o Bhaskar Kharat be released on bail on he executing P.R. Bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one solvent surety in like amount.

(iii) Applicant shall attend Police Station, Chikhali, Dist. Buldhana, once a week i.e. on every Sunday and shall be with the investigating officer from 03.00 p.m. to 05.00 p.m., till filing of the charge-sheet.
(iv) The observations made in this order are prima facie in nature and are made only for the purpose of deciding present application for bail.
At the time of trial, the learned trial Court shall not get influenced by any of the observations made in this order.
The application is disposed of.
